O.content: The blue line's Q4 endpoint is higher on the page than its Q1 endpoint.
The horizontal axis is labeled "Quarter" with Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4; the vertical axis is labeled "Revenue" and has printed values increasing upward from 0 to 1,600.

B.text: If the plotted line encodes Revenue by the left vertical axis and Q1-Q4 by the horizontal quarter labels, with larger revenue higher on the page, then a Q4 endpoint higher than the Q1 endpoint indicates an overall increase; treating any overall increase as growth maps it to the revenue growth response.
B.conditions: Assumes the visible line is Company C's revenue series and that endpoint increase, rather than the title's qualitative label, governs routing; no threshold is supplied.
